item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Café Reel With Matching Captions

turns.text: Make these into a 10-second vertical café reel with mellow music. Keep this order and put one caption on each photo: 'Come on in', 'Coffee first', 'Something sweet', 'Made with care', 'Stay a while'. Make the words easy to read.

item.tests: Checks exact caption wording, photo-caption alignment and readability in a short finished reel.

answer_sheet.Photo order and caption mapping: Storefront: Come on in. Latte: Coffee first. Pastries: Something sweet. Barista: Made with care. Interior: Stay a while.
answer_sheet.Caption language and styling: English, with the exact supplied wording. Font, placement and animation are your call, but keep everything easy to read.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Mellow music; track choice is your call. No voiceover needed.

must_haves: One vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds and includes all five supplied café photos in attachment order.
Each specified caption appears exactly, paired with its corresponding photo.
Captions remain visible long enough to read and are not clipped by the frame edges.
Caption contrast and placement keep the words legible over every photo.
Mellow music is audible beneath the photo sequence.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 café photo-slideshow reel using ALL FIVE supplied reference photographs in exactly the specified order. Preserve the actual photos and their contents rather than inventing replacement scenes. Each photograph occupies exactly two seconds, with gentle slow push-in motion and clean cuts at 2, 4, 6 and 8 seconds; do not morph between images. Fit each whole photo in the vertical frame using a softly blurred extension of that same photo as the background when necessary, avoiding cropping important contents. Timeline: 0.0–2.0 seconds @storefront with the exact caption 'Come on in'; 2.0–4.0 seconds @latte with exact caption 'Coffee first'; 4.0–6.0 seconds @pastries with exact caption 'Something sweet'; 6.0–8.0 seconds @barista with exact caption 'Made with care'; 8.0–10.0 seconds @interior with exact caption 'Stay a while'. Render only the one assigned caption on each photo, spelled exactly as supplied, no other words or logos. Captions must be easy to read on a phone: large bold clean sans-serif white lettering, centered horizontally in the lower-middle safe area, on a dark semi-opaque rounded rectangle with ample padding and strong contrast. Hold each caption clearly visible throughout its full two-second segment without text animation. Warm natural café atmosphere. Generate a mellow instrumental lo-fi café music bed with soft electric piano, warm bass and understated brushed percussion, no vocals or speech, no abrupt changes; gentle audio fade-in and fade-out.
